metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Rob McLarty.

plugins.name: plumbbob
plugins.description: Attention-first build process — driver skills + a CLI that keep you the decider; guidance, not enforcement.

plugins.name: jig
plugins.description: Guided per-repo workflows: /jig:version cuts a release from .claude/version.json and /jig:commit lands a conventional commit through a never-stage filter. User-invoked, script-backed skills only; nothing ambient.

plugins.name: ast-grep-rules
plugins.description: Adaptive structural lint for TypeScript — audit the conventions your docs state against the ast-grep rules you actually enforce, and turn recorded friction into new rules that ship with a passing test fixture.
